Main Roles

Main Roles

Deployment Strategist (DS)

Problem-solving leaders with a can-do mindset and strong technical fluency. Backgrounds include high-impact operational and technical roles, consultants, founders, or early startup employees, typically with CS or engineering degrees. Own deployment and are measured on customer P&L outcomes

Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Deployed engineers who are either generalists across integrations, agents, and data, or specialists such as telephony solution architects. Dive into complex workflows to design and ship AI agents that solve real business challenges.

Go To Market (GTM)
